attributes.name: Druva - Rare Administrator Login
attributes.description: Detects administrator/IP/location combinations observed no more than twice within the baseline window and explains why the login is considered rare.
author: Druva
tags: Druva Detection Pack 0 – Core Cyber Resilience

meta.pack: Druva Detection Pack 0 – Core Cyber Resilience
meta.external_dependency: Threat intelligence / VPN-TOR enrichment; GeoIP/location enrichment
meta.customer_usecase: Detects administrator/IP/location combinations observed no more than twice within the baseline window and explains why the login is considered rare.

attributes.query:
FROM logs-druva.event-*
| WHERE druva.feature == "Admin Event"
    AND druva.event_type == "Admin Login"

| EVAL admin = COALESCE(
    TO_STRING(user.name),
    TO_STRING(user.email)
  )

| EVAL login_ip = COALESCE(
    TO_STRING(source.ip),
    TO_STRING(source.ip),
    TO_STRING(source.ip)
  )

| EVAL location =
    COALESCE(
      TO_STRING(source.ip),
      "Unknown"
    )

| EVAL event_time =
    @timestamp

| EVAL login_hour =
    DATE_EXTRACT(
      "hour_of_day",
      event_time
    )

| EVAL outside_hours =
    login_hour < 7
    OR login_hour >= 19

| WHERE admin IS NOT NULL
    AND login_ip IS NOT NULL

| STATS
    occurrence_count = COUNT(*),

    first_seen =
      MIN(event_time),

    last_seen =
      MAX(event_time),

    login_hours =
      VALUES(login_hour),

    outside_hours_count =
      COUNT(*) WHERE outside_hours,

    representative_event_type =
      FIRST(druva.event_type, event_time),

    representative_event_details =
      FIRST(
        TO_STRING(message),
        event_time
      )

  BY admin, login_ip, location

| WHERE occurrence_count <= 2

| EVAL rarity_reason = CASE(
    occurrence_count == 1
      AND outside_hours_count > 0,
      "First observed IP/location + outside normal hours",

    occurrence_count == 1,
      "First observed IP/location",

    occurrence_count == 2
      AND outside_hours_count > 0,
      "Rare IP/location + outside normal hours",

    "Rare IP/location combination"
  )
